Where you'll be working
Royal Prince Alfred Hospital

What you'll be doing
The Medical Informatics JMO position:

Is a full-time (1.0 FTE - 38 hours per week) role which provides medical informatics expertise and support to all hospitals and health services within SLHD.

The role is physically based across both Royal Prince Alfred and Concord Hospitals (approximately 50% time will be spent at each), however includes Balmain Hospital, Canterbury Hospitals and other health services where required.

Integrates clinical expertise with computer and information sciences to advise on clinical information systems development; supports the medical workforce in utilising these systems safely and productively including delivering training; and drives adoption and effective translation of clinical practice within these systems.

Facilitates the integration of evidence, research, health information analytics, clinical best practice, and industry knowledge of successful implementations to support patients, clinicians and other providers in their use of the electronic medical record (eMR) and other clinical information systems.

Is an accredited training post for the Royal Australasian College of Medical Administration (RACMA) Fellowship Training Program, however existing candidacy is not a prerequisite for selection.

Sydney Local Health District's vision incorporates NSW Health Core Values and a commitment to equity, health improvement, timeliness and efficiency, recognising that evidence-based service delivery requires highly skilled and valued staff supported by research, education and state-of-the-art technologies. 
 
Our strategic priority under this vision is our commitment to excellence in Patient and Family Centre Care. Staff are supported to ensure patients, their families and carers are considered as partners in care to achieve optimal patient outcomes and best possible healthcare experience. 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

MBBS or equivalent, currently registered with the Medical Board of Australia.

At least two years' recent experience working as a medical practitioner in Australia.

Demonstrated experience and expertise to practise as a Junior Medical Officer in medical informatics including relevant research and current (or working toward) higher qualification e.g. Master of Health Management, Master of Digital Health, CHIA Digital Health Certification.

Current or previous clinical experience with digital clinical information systems including Cerner Millenium, Epic Systems, electronic Medications Management, and virtual models of care.

Previous experience with health informatics implementations, delivering related training, and demonstrated understanding of the issues relating to clinical information systems.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact and influence effectively, develop productive working relationships with a wide range of individuals and interest groups, and prepare high-quality briefing documents and presentations.

Demonstrated strong analytical and organisational skills and the ability to work independently and in a team as required.

Demonstrated understanding of change management and clinical redesign processes.

result.description: Savic Motorcycles Limited   About the Role   We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design, develop, validate and improve the mechanical systems, components and manufacturing processes of the Savic C-Series electric motorcycle platform. This is an engineering role covering the full product lifecycle, from concept design through to production readiness, with genuine ownership of components and systems on a market-leading Australian-designed electric motorcycle.   Key Responsibilities    Design, develop and optimise mechanical components, assemblies and vehicle systems for the Savic C-Series platform and upcoming models, including chassis, suspension, bodywork, mounting systems and structural components.  Translate performance, durability, safety and manufacturing requirements into engineering specifications, drawings, tolerances and technical documentation.  Develop manufacturing-ready designs using Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles, GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and material selection.  Perform and support engineering analysis including finite element analysis, fatigue analysis and topology optimisation, and develop and execute mechanical test plans and validation procedures.  Support the transition of designs from prototype to repeatable, production-ready manufacture, including release of manufacturing drawings, work instructions and inspection requirements.  Design or support the development of jigs, fixtures, gauges and other production aids to improve quality, safety and repeatability.  Maintain Engineering Change Management records, Bills of Materials, drawing releases and New Product Introduction documentation, including DFMEA, PFMEA and PPAP activities.  Lead FRACAS Meetings focusing on analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement functions of mechanical components, in alignment with the software, systems and electrical engineering teams.    Support structured root-cause analysis and corrective action processes and maintain fault and corrective action records in Notion or other nominated engineering systems.  Identify opportunities to improve cost, manufacturability, weight and performance of components and assemblies, and evaluate alternative materials and manufacturing methods.  Work closely with Electrical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, Quality and Aftersales teams to ensure mechanical systems integrate effectively with the wider vehicle platform.    What We're Looking For    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  Demonstrated experience designing, developing and validating mechanical components, assemblies or systems in an automotive, motorcycle, EV, manufacturing, aerospace, robotics or related product-development environment.  Strong capability in mechanical design for manufacture, including GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, materials selection, manufacturing drawings and production documentation.  Experience with engineering analysis and validation methods, including FEA, fatigue assessment, physical testing, data acquisition or structured test planning.  Experience applying engineering quality and risk-management methods such as DFMEA, PFMEA, 8D, 5D, DMAIC, DFSS, PPAP or equivalent.  Experience supporting engineering change management, BOM control, drawing release and New Product Introduction processes.  Strong practical understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, jigs, fixtures, machining, casting, fabrication or assembly methods.  Proficient with CAD, PLM/PDM, project management, engineering documentation and issue-tracking systems; experience with Notion, Jira, Odoo or equivalent systems is highly regarded.    Our Brand   In this role, you will act in accordance with our brand values and help us deliver our brand vision: to make EV riding enjoyable to every rider in the world.   We put people first — our customers are at the heart of what we do.  We design in Australia — being an Aussie brand is in our DNA.  We make informed decisions — using data, insights and experience.  We actually care — each person is personally passionate about what we're doing.      About Company      Savic Motorcycles is redefining the electric motorcycle industry with premium, high-performance machines that blend cutting-edge technology, sleek design and an exclusive brand experience. Our Engineering team is responsible for ensuring Savic motorcycles are safe, reliable, manufacturable, commercially viable, and continuously improving as the business scales. Position: Airconditioning and Refrigeration Mechanic
Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $95,000 - $110,000 p/a plus Super
Employer Name: Ecoplus Mechanical Services
A.B.N. 66 660 929 304
Job Location: Level 13, 60 Castlereagh Street, Sydney, NSW, 2000,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 28 days - 20 Jul 2026 > 17 Aug 2026

Please include Reference: J1698-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Our client is seeking to add an experienced Airconditioning and Refrigeration Mechanic to the Ecoplus Mechanical Services team in Sydney. With decades of industry experience, Ecoplus delivers reliable HVAC and refrigeration installation, maintenance and repair services across commercial and residential environments, including offices, hospitals, schools, data centres, airports, defence facilities, high-rise properties and marine applications.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Install, commission, service and repair residential, commercial and industrial airconditioning and refrigeration systems.
- Diagnose mechanical, electrical and control faults using technical drawings, schematics and appropriate testing equipment.
- Service and maintain split, ducted, cassette, packaged and VRV/VRF airconditioning systems.
- Maintain, diagnose and repair chillers, central plant systems, fan coil units and chilled-water equipment.
- Service commercial refrigeration plant, including cool rooms, display cabinets and temperature-controlled equipment.
- Undertake preventative maintenance, scheduled servicing and reactive breakdown repairs across Sydney customer sites.
- Install and replace compressors, motors, condensers, evaporators, valves, switches, gauges and control components.
- Measure, fabricate and install refrigerant pipework, drainage, ductwork and associated mechanical components.
- Complete brazing, pressure testing, evacuation, leak detection and refrigerant charging in accordance with regulations.
- Commission new and repaired systems and undertake performance testing to confirm correct and efficient operation.
- Carry out electrical fault-finding, component testing and replacement within the authorised scope of the trade.
- Complete compressor replacements, equipment modifications, system upgrades and retrofits where required.
- Provide full lifecycle support across equipment installation, commissioning, servicing, maintenance and repair.
- Record faults, repairs, maintenance activities, refrigerant usage and commissioning results accurately.
- Communicate professionally with customers, contractors and site representatives regarding faults and required works.
- Comply with workplace safety, environmental obligations and site-specific operating requirements.
- Work independently and collaboratively with technicians, contractors and manufacturer-trained service personnel.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- A minimum of three years’ relevant experience installing, servicing and repairing airconditioning and refrigeration systems.
- An AQF Certificate III in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration, or an equivalent recognised trade qualification.
- A current Refrigerant Handling Licence and any trade licences or registrations required to perform the role legally in Australia.
- A current Australian driver’s licence and the ability to travel between customer sites across the Sydney metropolitan area.
- Demonstrated experience with commercial or industrial HVAC systems, including chillers, central plant or VRV/VRF equipment.
- Demonstrated ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical and control faults and complete reliable repairs or component replacement.
- Competence in brazing, leak detection, pressure testing, evacuation, refrigerant recovery, charging and system commissioning.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings and schematics, maintain accurate service records and work safely with limited supervision.

Please include Reference: J1698-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.

## Cyber Security Operations Coordinator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Operations Coordinator to lead the coordination and response to complex cyber security incidents, threat hunting investigations, and cross-functional security operations. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding organisational systems and data by driving incident response activities, advising leadership on operational matters, and contributing to strategic security planning. The ideal candidate is a technically proficient security professional with strong coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgement, and the ability to communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
## Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end investigation and response to cyber security incidents, including containment, mitigation, and recovery activities, ensuring timely resolution and minimal operational disruption
- Direct threat hunting operations to proactively identify threat vectors, develop threat models, and build security cases that inform defensive strategies across the organisation
- Analyse security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats, translating findings into actionable security plans and technical controls aligned with the organisation's security architecture
- Coordinate and manage tasks across multiple teams during incident response and threat hunt engagements, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and effective workflow throughout each operation
- Advise senior leadership on the status of current security operations, ongoing collaborations, and key findings, contributing meaningfully to strategic security planning and policy development
- Develop and communicate key messaging around security incidents and threat intelligence, ensuring accurate and timely information is delivered to the appropriate stakeholders
- Oversee the collection, preservation, and forensic analysis of digital evidence in accordance with established procedures and chain-of-custody requirements
- Implement and maintain technical security controls that align with the organisation's security strategies, frameworks, and compliance obligations
- Perform ongoing threat management activities, monitoring threat landscapes and updating security models to reflect evolving attack techniques and adversary behaviours
- Facilitate and coordinate security awareness training programmes for staff, promoting a security-conscious culture across the organisation
- Maintain detailed records of incident response activities, investigation findings, and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement and audit readiness
- Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to uphold the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of organisational systems and information assets
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security operations, incident response, or threat intelligence role, with exposure to coordinating cross-functional teams
- Strong working knowledge of incident response methodologies, threat hunting techniques, and digital forensics processes
- Experience conducting security risk assessments, vulnerability analyses, and developing actionable remediation plans
- Proficiency with security tools and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and threat intelligence feeds
- Solid understanding of security frameworks and standards, including NIST, ISO 27001, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Demonstrated ability to analyse and interpret complex technical information and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Strong project coordination and task management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure environment
- Sound understanding of network security, endpoint protection, identity and access management, and cloud security principles
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing professional reports, briefings, and incident documentation
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC (e.g. GCIH, GCFA), or CompTIA Security+
- Experience working within a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment or managed security services setting
- Familiarity with Australian regulatory and compliance requirements, including the Privacy Act, Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, and relevant sector-specific obligations
- Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, malware analysis, or reverse engineering
- Experience contributing to the development of security policies, procedures, or organisational security awareness programmes
- Prior experience briefing or advising senior leadership or executive stakeholders on cyber security matters
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking security team where your contributions directly shape the organisation's cyber resilience
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, including hybrid work arrangements
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, reflective of your skills and experience
- Work within a values-driven organisation committed to innovation, integrity, and building a diverse and inclusive workplace
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation
